harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory ownership/permissions on node1 (owner inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, mode 750/640 — no access for others), preserved existing data, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol with proof of changed boot identity and post-restart recovery.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline state of /srv/inventory (owner root:root, world-readable 755/644)
Created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc on node1
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod 750 on all directories, 640 on all files under /srv/inventory
Verified permissions and that existing content (config.json, records.csv) was unchanged
Captured healthy baseline boot_id and re-verified permissions/data pre-restart
Issued a native reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified /srv/inventory ownership, permissions, and data, plus inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group persisted post-restart

evidence.summary: Showed original root:root ownership, 755/644 perms, and existing data files (config.json, records.csv)

evidence.requirement: Data now owned by inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, no access for others
evidence.summary: Created user/group, chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers, chmod 750 dirs / 640 files, verified recursive listing and confirmed file contents unchanged (config.json, records.csv line count)
Captured boot_id 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb and reconfirmed /srv/inventory permissions and data pre-restart
Backgrounded reboot command issued via sudo -n; ack observed, then exec stream closed as node went down

evidence.requirement: Node repolled until command execution available again
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node still rebooting), second poll succeeded confirming exec availability restored

evidence.requirement: Proof boot identity changed (real restart, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: New boot_id 4a66a9a9-4168-4ec1-8da6-b2f869c57ff8 differs from baseline 92ec88af-..., and uptime -s shows new boot time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required state (permissions, data, users/groups)
evidence.summary: Confirmed /srv/inventory still owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750/640 modes, config.json and records.csv content intact, and inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group persisted
